Oniguruma 6.9.10 (https://github.com/kkos/oniguruma, tag v6.9.10), BSD-2-Clause, see COPYING.
Vendored subset: the regex core plus the ASCII and UTF-16LE encodings and the Unicode tables (src/*.c, src/*.h),
so the build needs no network access. Unmodified upstream files; config.h is generated by ../../CMakeLists.txt
from src/config.h.cmake.in. ONIG_ENCODING_UTF16_LE is the only encoding the TextMate engine uses.
